{{Quote|Tonnis sector? That's just empty space out there. No settlements or stations.|[[Sabine Wren]]|<ref name="ITOTR" />}}
The '''Tonnis sector''' was a [[sector]] located in [[the galaxy]]. Remote and devoid of settlements, it was considered little more than empty space.<ref name="ITOTR" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e8-trivia-gallery|text="Narkina 5" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> [[Freighter 2716]], secretly transporting a giant [[kyber crystal]] intended for use in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], rendezvoused with [[Captain]] [[Slavin]]'s [[Slavin's Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] there. Both ships were destroyed when the crystal, which had been rigged into a bomb by notorious extremist [[Saw Gerrera]], exploded.<ref name="ITOTR" />
